notes.text: Diplomatic Recognition - Pakistan becomes 3rd non-communist country to recognize PRC (after UK & Burma).
UN GA Vote - Pakistan votes in favor of PRC replacing Taiwan (ROC) in the UN General Assembly.
Sino-Pakistan Border Agreement - Pakistan cedes Shaksgam Valley to China (part of Gilgit- Baltistan); 5100 sq km handed over.
Start of Karakoram Highway (KKH) - Jointly built as a symbol of friendship. Construction starts in 1966.
Nixon's Visit - Pakistan facilitates secret visit of Henry Kissinger to China → leads to President Nixon's visit in 1972.
KKH Completed - Construction completed.
KKH Opened for Public - Officially opened to general traffic.
Year/Date: KKH Route; Event/Agreement: Highway Info; Details: N-35 (Pakistan): Hassan Abdal to Khunjerab Pass; G314 (China): Khunjerab to Kashgar.
Chashma Nuclear Cooperation - China agrees to help Pakistan build Chashma Nuclear Power Plants (C-1 & C-2).
Defence Industry Cooperation - Support in HMC (Heavy Mechanical Complex) and HIT (Heavy Industries Taxila).
JF-17 Thunder Jet Project - Joint production started at PAC Kamra.
1st FTA Signed - Free Trade Agreement signed (in goods, effective 2007).
CPEC Announced - China-Pakistan Economic Corridor launched under Belt & Road Initiative (BRI).
Year/Date: 2015-2019; Event/Agreement: CPEC Phase 1; Details: Focused on energy (Thermal Power Plants), roads, Orange Line, optical fibre (RWP-Khunjerab).
2nd FTA Signed - Improved terms for market access (FTA-II).

Year/Date: 2019- ongoing; Event/Agreement: CPEC Phase 2; Details: Focus on ML-1 railway (Karachi to Peshawar Track Upgradtion), (SEZs, Technical University, dams are in progress), Gwadar Airport (completed).
Trade Status - Pakistan becomes China's largest import partner (China is Pakistan's biggest import origin).
Year/Date: 21 May 2025; Event/Agreement: Pak, China, Afghanistan meetup; Details: The Foreign Ministers of 3 countries met in Beijing and showed willingness to restore diplomatic ties.
Karachi Agreement - Established Kashmir ceasefire line, UN supervision
Article 370 (Part of Indian Constitution of 1949) - Only Finance, Defense, Commerce and Foreign Policy to Central Govt.
Article 35A (Added in Constitution of India) - Scholarships, Land, Marriage with locals, govt jobs banned to outsiders.
J&K Assembly Ratified Accession - Ratified Kashmir's accession to India; Pakistan rejected.
2nd Indo-Pak War - Started due to Operation Gibraltar in Kashmir; ended with UN ceasefire.
Tashkent Agreement - Peace accord between Ayub Khan & Lal Bahadur Shastri, mediated by USSR.
3rd Indo-Pak War - Caused by East Pakistan crisis; resulted in Bangladesh's creation.
Shimla Agreement - Turned ceasefire line into LOC, emphasized peaceful resolution.
Smiling Buddha - India's first nuclear test at Pokhran (Rajasthan)
Siachen Conflict - India occupied Siachen Glacier (Operation Meghdoot).
Kashmir Insurgency Begins - Armed revolt starts; Pakistan accused of fueling militancy.
Nuclear Info Exchange Agreement - Annual exchange of nuclear site lists between India & Pakistan on 1st Jan each year.
India Granted MFN (Most Favoured Nation) Status to Pakistan - Pakistan did not reciprocate.
*If Country A grants MFN to Country B, it must give the same trade benefits (low tariffs, no discrimination) to Country B as it gives to any other country.
Pokhran-II (5 boms detonated) & Chaghi Tests (5 on 28 May in Ras Koh Hills, Chaghi & 1 on 30 May in Kharan Desert) - India & Pakistan both conducted nuclear tests.
Lahore Declaration - PMs pledged nuclear restraint and improved ties. Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee visited Lahore, Pakistan.
Kargil War - Pakistani forces infiltrated; India recaptured Kargil heights.
J&K Assembly Attack - Major terror attack in Srinagar Assembly. Allegedly by Laskar e Taiba(LET), Jaish e Muhammad (JEM)
Indian Parliament Attack - Blamed on JEM; led to military standoff.
Samjhauta Express Blast - Bombing near Panipat; 68 people (mostly Pakistanis) killed.
Mumbai Taj Attacks - Lashkar-e-Taiba (allegedly) conducted major terror attack in Mumbai.
Pakistan Agreed MFN in Principle - Never implemented due to domestic opposition.
Udhampur BSF Attack - Militants killed Indian forces in Kashmir.
Kulbhushan Jadhav Arrested - Indian spy caught in Balochistan; later sentenced.
Burhan Wani Killed - Sparked mass protests in Kashmir.
Uri Attack - 19 Indian soldiers killed; blamed on Pakistan-based militants.
Pulwama Attack - Suicide blast killed 40 CRPF troops; JeM claimed responsibility.
Balakot Airstrikes - India bombed alleged JeM camp in Balakot.
Swift Retort - Pakistan captured and returned Indian pilot Abhinandan.
Article 370 Revoked - India ended J&K's special status and split it into two Union Territories.
Kartarpur Corridor Opened - 4.7 km religious corridor for Sikh pilgrims to visit Kartarpur.
Yasin Malik's (Head of JKLF) life Imprisonment - Accusations of terrorism and sedition
Pahlgam attack(23 April), Operation Sindhoor (7 May), Operation Banyan ul Masroor (10 May) - India accused Pakistan of terror attack in Pahalgam.
Mediated by - World Bank
Signed by - Nehru (India) & Ayub Khan (Pakistan)
Eastern Rivers - Beas, Ravi, Sutlej - India's exclusive use
Western Rivers - Indus, Jhelum, Chenab - Pakistan's main share
India's Rights - Non-consumptive use, limited storage, run-of-the-river hydropower
Pakistan's Dams - India had to pay 174 million pounds for construction of Tarbela & Mangla dams, and link canals.
Baglihar Dam (On Chenab) - Neutral Expert allowed India with design limits (Verdict: 2007)
Kishanganga Dam (On Neelum River) - PCA allowed India with minimum flow to Pak (Verdict: 2013)
Treaty Suspended - 23 April, 2025
Feature; India; Pakistan
Nuclear Warheads; ~180 (As per Sipri ,2025 report); ~170 (As per Sipri, 2025 report)
Top Missile; Agni-V - 5,000+ km; Shaheen-III - 2,750 km
Event: Durand Line Signed; Year: 1893; Details: Between British India & Afghanistan; border dispute persists
Event: Afghanistan Didn't Recognize Pakistan; Year: 1947; Details: Due to Durand Line and Pashtun nationalist issues
Event: One Unit Problem; Year: 1955; Details: Afghanistan objected to Pakistan's One Unit policy due to NWFP's inclusion in it.
Event: Afghan Jihad; Year: 1979-1989; Details: Pakistan supports Afghan mujahideen against Soviet forces
Event: Pakistan Recognizes Taliban; Year: 1996; Details: Pakistan officially recognizes Taliban rule in Afghanistan
Event: APTTA Signed; Year: 2010; Details: Afghanistan-Pakistan Transit Trade Agreement
Event: QCG Formed; Year: 2016; Details: Quadrilateral Contact Group (Afghanistan, Pakistan, China, USA) for peace in Afghanistan
Event: Refugees Inflow; Year: 1979 onwards; Details: >Over 3 million Afghan refugees fled to Pakistan >As of 2024, Pakistan hosts over 1.3 million registered Afghan refugees, according to UNHCR
Event/Agreement: U-2 Incident (Badaber Airbase); Year: 1960; Details: A U.S. spy plane (U-2) flown from Badaber Airbase near Peshawar was shot down by the USSR; worsened Pak-USSR ties.
Tashkent Agreement Mediated by USSR - 1966
Event/Agreement: Guddu Thermal Power Plant; Year: 1972; Details: Built with Soviet assistance in Sindh; major early energy project.
Event/Agreement: Pakistan Steel Mills; Year: 1973 (foundation); Details: USSR helped establish PSM in Karachi
Event/Agreement: Geneva Accords (Afghan Peace Deal); Year: 1988; Details: Agreements signed between Pakistan, Afghanistan, USA, and USSR to end Soviet-Afghan war; led to Soviet withdrawal.
Russia lifted Arms Embargo - 2014
Event/Agreement: MI-35 Attack Helicopter Deal; Year: 2015; Details: Pakistan signed a deal to purchase 25 MI-35 helicopters from Russia.
Event/Agreement: Military Exercises (Joint Drills); Year: Since 2016; Details: Pakistan and Russia conduct joint military drills named "Druzhba" (Friendship).

Event/Agreement: Energy Cooperation Talks; Year: Ongoing (2010s-2020s); Details: North-South Gas Pipeline Project (Renamed Pakistan Stream Gas Pipeline in 2021) (From Karachi to Kasur, Pakistan has 74% stakes of it while Russia has 26%) to transport Natural gas.
Event/Agreement: Revival of Pakistan Steel Mills; Year: 12 July 2025; Details: Protocol Signed
Event / Topic: 1st Country to Recognize Pakistan; Year: 1947; Details: Iran was the first country to recognize Pakistan after independence.
Event / Topic: Member of RCD (Regional Cooperation for Development); Year: 1964; Details: Both part of it
Event / Topic: RCD Converted to ECO (Economic Cooperation Organization); Year: 1985; Details: Both part of it
Event / Topic: Supported Iran During Iran-Iraq War; Year: 1980- 1988; Details: Pakistan remained officially neutral but leaned toward Iran diplomatically.
Iran Protested Presence of Jundullah - Iran criticized Pakistan for alleged presence of anti-Iran terrorist group Jundullah near the border.
Event / Topic: PTA (Preferential Trade Agreement); Year: 2004; Details: Aimed to reduce tariffs on selected goods to boost bilateral trade.
Event / Topic: Trade Facilitation Plan (TFP); Year: 2015; Details: Agreement to improve border trade, customs cooperation, and transport.
Event / Topic: Border Crossings Established / Upgraded; Year: Recent Years; Details: Crossings like Gabd-Rimdan, Taftan-Mirjaveh, Mand-Pishin opened/upgraded for trade and people-to-people contact.

Event / Topic: Iran-Pakistan (IP) Gas Pipeline Project; Year: Signed 2009; Details: Also called Peace Pipeline, it aims to transport natural gas from Iran's South Pars field to Pakistan (and originally India). Delayed due to sanctions and funding issues. Construction on Pakistan side stalled; Iran has partially completed its section.
Event / Topic: Khilafat Movement; Year: 1919- 1924; Details: Indian Muslims (including future Pakistanis) supported Turkey's Ottoman Caliphate.
Event / Topic: Treaty of Eternal Friendship; Year: 1951; Details: Formalized strong diplomatic relations post- Pakistan's independence.
Event / Topic: Joined CENTO with Turkey; Year: 1955; Details: Military and economic alliance during Cold War.
Event / Topic: Super Mushak Aircraft Export; Year: 2016; Details: Pakistan sold 52 Super Mushak trainer aircraft to Turkey.
Event / Topic: T129 ATAK Helicopter Deal &Milgem Submarine Deal; Year: 2018; Details: Pakistan signed deal for 30 T129 ATAK helicopters & 4 Submarines; delayed over U.S. export license.
Event / Topic: F-16 Modernization Agreement; Year: 2009; Details: Turkey helped modernize Pakistan Air Force F- 16s.
Event / Topic: AMAN Naval Exercises; Year: Since 2007; Details: Turkey regularly participates in Pakistan-led multinational maritime exercises.
Event / Topic: Erdogan's Visit to Pakistan; Year: 2016; Details: Addressed joint session of Parliament; emphasized deepening ties.
Event / Topic: Support for Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus; Year: Ongoing; Details: Pakistan supports Turkey's stance despite not formally recognizing it.
Pakistan joined SEATO - Aligned with U.S. during Cold War.
Pakistan joined CENTO - Strengthened military bloc ties.
Year: 1950s- 60s; Event: $2.5 Billion U.S. Aid; Details: Economic and military assistance to Pakistan.
Year: 1979- 1989; Event: Afghan Jihad; Details: Pakistan-US supported Mujahideen vs USSR.
War on Terror Begins - Pakistan became a front-line ally after 9/11.

A.Q. Khan Issue - Exposed nuclear proliferation by Pakistani scientist. Involved in handing over nuclear technology information to Iran, North Korea, and Libya. Confessed on National TV, and put in house arrest.

U.S.-India Nuclear Deal - Caused concern in Pakistan over strategic imbalance. (Signed in 2005, allowing India to access U.S. nuclear technology and fuel despite being outside the NPT, for civilian purposes)
Osama bin Laden Killed in Abbottabad - U.S. raid without prior intimation soured ties.
Raymond Davis Incident - CIA agent arrested for double murder in Lahore.
Salala Checkpost Incident - NATO airstrike killed 24 Pakistani soldiers; routes blocked.
Year: March 2025; Event: ISIS-K terrorist capture; Details: Muhammad Sharifullah (ISIS-K terrorist involved in Abbey Gate Bombing) arrested by Pakistan and handed to the USA
21 June 2025 - Nominated Trump for Nobel Prize
Year: 2023- 24; Event: U.S. = Top Export Partner of Pakistan; Details: Exports: $5.61 billion (mainly textiles, IT); trade surplus.
Saudi Arabia recognized Pakistan - Among the first countries to recognize Pakistan.
Faisal Masjid construction begins - Gift from King Faisal; inaugurated in 1986; largest mosque in Pakistan.
Grand Mosque Seizure in Makkah - Pakistani SSG commandos helped retake the mosque from extremists.
Afghan Jihad support - Joint support for Afghan Mujahideen during Soviet invasion.
Gulf War - Pakistan sent troops to defend Saudi Arabia.
Post-nuclear sanctions relief - Saudi Arabia provided 2 billion dollar oil facility after Pakistan's nuclear tests.
$6 billion aid package - $3B deposit + $3B oil facility to support Pakistan's economy.
Crown Prince MBS visit to Pakistan - MoUs worth $20 billion signed, including refinery in Gwadar.
Year: 2023- 24; Event / Agreement: Top remittance source for Pakistan; Details: $7.42 billion remitted from Saudi Arabia - highest from any country..
Date: 14 September 2026; Pakistan monetary policy: The State Bank of Pakistan kept the policy rate unchanged at 11.5%.
Date: 14 September 2026; Pakistan fuel relief: The ECC approved Rs500 per week for two- and three-wheelers and Rs1,000 for ten days for non-commercial cars up to 800cc under the Fuel Relief Scheme.

Date: 14 September 2026; Pakistan law: The Islamabad High Court directed that state resources and government personnel must not be used for political protests and that Islamabad roads cannot lawfully be blocked by political actors.

Date: 14 September 2026; Pakistan power sector: The first meeting of the Steering Committee on Power Sector Regulatory Regime – Improvement & Reforms focused on regulatory predictability, investment, efficiency and competition.
Date: 14 September 2026; Pakistan SOEs: The Cabinet Committee on State-Owned Enterprises reviewed federal SOE performance for the first half of FY2025-26.
Date: 14 September 2026; SCO digital economy: Pakistan called for stronger SCO cooperation on digital economy and AI at the SCO Digital Economy Forum 2026 in Urumqi, China.
Date: 14 September 2026; Pakistan–Lebanon relations: The two countries signed an MoU on the Transfer of Sentenced Persons during the Lebanese interior minister’s visit.
Date: 14 September 2026; Frontier debt: JPMorgan said its GBI-EM Edge local-currency government bond index would include Pakistan at the maximum 8% country weighting.
Pakistan and Canada agreed on 15 September 2026 to accelerate negotiations on a Foreign Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement (FIPA); the next round is expected in the first week of October.
Reuters reported on 15 September 2026 that LNG demand in China, India and Pakistan is expected to rebound after the Middle East war ends.
Pakistan announced fuel-conservation austerity measures on 17 September 2026; its relief policy offered eligible small-vehicle users a Rs100-per-litre petrol subsidy within capped quotas.
Pakistan's fully drawn currency-swap line with China is 30 billion yuan; Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb said Pakistan would seek an expansion when it expires in 2027.
Pakistan's total liquid foreign reserves stood at $26.7912 billion as of 11 September 2026; SBP-held reserves were $21.389 billion.
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif will lead Pakistan's delegation to the high-level segment of the 81st UN General Assembly.
A 17 September 2026 LHC petition challenged Section 21AAA of Punjab's amended anti-terror law governing confidential terrorism trials.
Pakistan ranked 143rd with a 59.5% parity score in the World Economic Forum's Global Gender Gap Report 2026.
Pakistan and China concluded the inaugural Boundary Joint Commission meeting in Islamabad on 16-17 September 2026.
Pakistan and the IAEA signed a safeguards agreement for the 1,200 MW Chashma-5 nuclear power plant.
US drone firm Powerus said its MoU with the Pakistan Army includes an initial order in the unmanned aerial systems category.
Pakistan recorded a $98 million current-account deficit in August 2026, while FDI reached $315.9 million.
Pakistan's Large Scale Manufacturing output rose 3.03% year-on-year in July 2026; the QIM stood at 119.13.
The death toll from the Kohat police compound attack rose to 31 on 19 September 2026.
Pakistan approved SMS redemption of fuel-relief tokens for stations in areas without internet connectivity.
The Gilgit-Baltistan Assembly approved a budget of over Rs218 billion for the current financial year.
Pakistan's National Cybersecurity Handbook 2026-27 restricts officials from putting sensitive government information into public AI tools.
Pakistan and Malaysia agreed to expand trade and economic cooperation and meet during the 81st UN General Assembly.
Pakistan reiterated that Afghan soil must not be used for terrorism inside Pakistan, with DG ISPR referring to Doha Agreement commitments.
